bullets: In Thiruvallur, a 45-year-old man died by suicide due to alleged financier harassment, prompting a police complaint by his wife that the district team must monitor.
The office should watch the police investigation into the Eekadu financier harassment case to ensure appropriate action is taken against the accused.
The Chennai Corporation identified 219 vulnerable locations and desilted 1,102 km of stormwater drains ahead of the monsoon, and the constituency team should track canal work progress.
GCC will upgrade 780 damaged roads across 15 zones for 150 crore rupees, and the office must monitor the implementation of these detailed project reports.
Birders spotted a pair of Terek sandpipers at the Pallikaranai marshland, raising the wetland bird tally to 205, which the constituency team should note for environmental updates.
Walgreens is setting up its first India Global Capability Center at DLF Downtown in Taramani, Chennai, and the portfolio team should welcome and facilitate this investment.
The office should watch the progress of the new Taramani facility to support further IT and digital sector growth in the region.
